Best PRP Clinic in Trivandrum for Hair and Skin Rejuvenation

Noticing more hair in the shower drain? Frustrated by acne scars that won’t fade or fine lines that keep deepening? You’ve probably tried countless products—only to see temporary fixes at best.

What if your body could heal itself?

PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) Therapy uses your own blood’s natural growth factors to:

  • Revive thinning hair by strengthening follicles
  • Smooth acne scars and uneven texture
  • Reduce wrinkles by boosting collagen

No harsh chemicals. No artificial fillers. Just your body’s healing power, amplified.

What is PRP Therapy and How Does It Work?

Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) Therapy is a groundbreaking regenerative treatment that taps into your body’s natural healing ability. By using platelets extracted from your blood, PRP is injected into targeted areas to boost regeneration, stimulate hair follicles, enhance collagen production, and more.

How PRP Therapy Works:
  1. A small blood sample is taken.
  2. The sample is spun in a centrifuge to separate platelets and plasma.
  3. Concentrated PRP is injected into the scalp, skin, or joints to rejuvenate and repair the area.
PRP Therapy at Facelit Clinic

Facelit Clinic uses an advanced double-spin centrifugation method to ensure the PRP is highly potent and effective. This meticulous process enhances the therapy's results, whether for hair regrowth, skin rejuvenation, or joint repair.

1. PRP for Hair Restoration Struggling with thinning hair or baldness? Facelit Clinic’s PRP therapy stimulates hair follicle regeneration, encouraging natural hair growth. Ideal for: - Male and female pattern baldness - Post-pregnancy hair loss - General hair thinning Results: - Thicker, healthier hair after 3–6 sessions. 2. PRP for Skin Rejuvenation Revitalize your skin with PRP therapy. This treatment enhances collagen production to reduce wrinkles, fine lines, and scars while improving skin texture and tone. Ideal for: - Aging skin - Acne scars - Uneven skin tone - Sun damage Results: - Firmer, smoother, youthful-looking skin with a natural glow.

The procedure is minimally invasive, safe, and typically lasts 30–60 minutes. 4. Aftercare Support Post-treatment instructions are provided to maximize results and ensure a smooth recovery.

FAQ

  • 1. What makes Facelit Clinic the best in Trivandrum?

    Facelit Clinic combines advanced technology, experienced professionals, and personalized care to deliver exceptional results in PRP therapy.

  • 2. How many sessions will I need?

    Most clients require 3–6 sessions for optimal results, depending on the treatment area and individual goals.

  • 3. Is PRP therapy safe?

    Yes, PRP therapy is safe and uses your own blood, minimizing the risk of adverse reactions.

  • 4. What is the cost of PRP therapy at Facelit Clinic?

    The fee depends on the treatment area and individual needs

  • 5. Can I combine PRP therapy with other treatments?

    Absolutely! The specialists at Facelit Clinic can create a comprehensive plan combining PRP with other procedures to enhance results.

  • 6. How long does it take to see results from PRP therapy?

    Results from PRP therapy vary depending on the individual and the treatment area. For hair restoration, noticeable improvements often appear after 3–4 months. Skin rejuvenation results, like improved texture and reduced wrinkles, may be visible within 2–3 weeks, with optimal results seen after multiple sessions.

  • 7. Are there any risks or side effects of PRP therapy?

    PRP therapy is considered safe because it uses your own blood, reducing the risk of allergic reactions. Some minor side effects, such as redness, swelling, or mild discomfort at the injection site, may occur but typically subside within a few days.

  • 8. Is there any downtime after a PRP session?

    One of the advantages of PRP therapy is its minimal downtime. Most patients can resume their daily activities immediately after the procedure. However, it’s advised to avoid strenuous activities and sun exposure for at least 24–48 hours post-treatment.

  • 9. Can PRP therapy help with acne scars?

    Yes, PRP therapy is highly effective for reducing acne scars. By stimulating collagen production, it helps improve skin texture, filling in scars and giving the skin a smoother appearance.

  • 10. Who is an ideal candidate for PRP therapy?

    PRP therapy is suitable for most individuals seeking natural solutions for hair loss, aging skin, or joint pain. However, it may not be recommended for people with blood disorders, active infections, or those on certain medications. A consultation at Facelit Clinic can determine your eligibility.

  • 11. How long does a PRP session take?

    A typical PRP session at Facelit Clinic takes about 30–60 minutes, depending on the area being treated. The process includes blood collection, PRP preparation, and application, making it a quick and convenient procedure for most clients.
